questions.question: An aquarium is in the form of a cuboid whose external measures are 80 cm × 30 cm × 40 cm. The base, side faces and back face are to be covered with a coloured paper. Find the area of the paper needed?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total paper area = Area of (**Base** + **Back Face** + **2 × Side Faces**)

Required area = (80 × 30) + (80 × 40) + 2(30 × 40)

Required area = 2400 + 3200 + 2400 = 8000 cm²

Therefore, the area of the paper needed is 8000 cm², which matches **Option (2)**.

**∴ The correct answer is 8000 cm².**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ **Length (l)** of the aquarium = 80 cm

⇒ **Width (w)** of the aquarium = 30 cm

⇒ **Height (h)** of the aquarium = 40 cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2440d075f9a2fcb927300f962b39466007926d20b2a1c5b32f16a66a6c64d21.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of the **Base** = l × w = 80 × 30 = 2400 cm²

⇒ Area of the **Back face** = l × h = 80 × 40 = 3200 cm²

⇒ Area of **one side face** = w × h = 30 × 40 = 1200 cm²

⇒ Area of **two side faces** = 2 × 1200 = 2400 cm²

⇒ **Total area of paper needed** = Area of Base + Area of Back face + Area of two side faces

⇒ Total Area = 2400 + 3200 + 2400 = 8000 cm²

This result corresponds to the value given in **Option (2)**.

**∴ The correct answer is 8000 cm².**

**__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cuboid

The total surface area (TSA) covers all six faces and is given by the formula 2(lw + wh + hl).

Lateral Surface Area (Area of 4 walls)

The area of the vertical faces (excluding top and base) is given by 2h(l + w).

Volume of a Cuboid

The amount of space inside the cuboid (capacity) is calculated as Volume = l × w × h.

Diagonal of a Cuboid

The longest rod that can be placed inside a cuboid is √(l² + w² + h²).</p

questions.question: How much does one need to add to (1)/(2) to get 2?

Fraction = (1)/(2) 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let x be added to (1)/(2) to get 2

⇒ 2 = (1)/(2) + x

⇒ x = 2 – (1)/(2) = (4-1)/(2)

⇒ x = (3)/(2)

**Therefore, (3)/(2) is needed to add to (1)/(2) to get 2**

questions.question: The sum of two numbers is 66 and their HCF and LCM are 3 and 315 respectively. The sum of the reciprocals of the numbers will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

HCF = 3

LCM = 315

Sum of two numbers = 66

**Concept Used:**

LCM × HCF = Product of two numbers

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let, the numbers be a and b.

⇒ a + b = 66

⇒ According to the formula,

⇒ 3 × 315 = a × b

⇒ Required sum = (1)/(a) + (1)/(b) = ((a + b))/(ab)

⇒ Putting the values, we get

⇒ (66)/(3 × 315) = (66)/(945)=(22)/(315)

**Therefore, the sum of their reciprocals is (22)/(315).**

questions.question: John is twice as old as Jean. After 3 years, the sum of their ages will be 66 years. What are the present ages of Jean and John, respectively?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Age of John = Twice of Jean's age

Sum of their ages after three years = 66 years

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the present age of Jean be y years.

⇒ So, the Present age of John = 2y

⇒ Sum of their ages after three years = 66 years

⇒ Therefore, sum of their present ages = 66 – 6 = 60 years

⇒ 2y + y = 60 years

⇒ y = (60)/(3) = 20 years

⇒ Present age of Jean = y = 20 years

⇒ Present age of John = 2y = 2 × 20 = 40 years

**Therefore, the present ages of Jean and John is 20 and 40 years, respectively.**

__
 
• **Goods and Service Tax**

 
 
• Goods and Service Tax is officially known as** The Constitution (One Hundred and First Amendment) Act, 2016.**
 
• This amendment introduced a national Goods and Services Tax (GST) in India on **1 July 2017.**
 
• It was introduced as the** One Hundred and one Amendment Bill** of the Constitution of India.
 
• The Goods and Services Tax (GST) is a **Value added Tax (VAT).**
 
• It proposed to be a comprehensive indirect tax levy on the manufacture, sale, and consumption of goods as well as services at the national level.

questions.question: Find the number of bricks measuring 25 cm in length, 5 cm in breadth and 20 cm in height for a wall 40 m long, 80 cm broad and 6 m in height.

Volume of cuboid = l × b × h

⇒ Height of wall = 6 m = 6 × 100 = 600 cm

⇒ Volume of a brick = 25 × 5 × 20 = 2500 cm³

⇒ Number of bricks required = (192000000)/(2500) = 76800

• As cyber threats evolved, so did firewall technology, leading to the development of stateful inspection firewalls, which could make decisions based on the context of network traffic.
 
• The introduction of next-generation firewalls (NGFW) brought features such as application awareness and control, integrated intrusion prevention, and cloud-delivered threat intelligence.

questions.question: A sample of milk from a vessel contains 4% water. What quantity of pure milk should be added to 8 L of milk in the vessel to reduce the water content to 2%?

**Given:**

Percentage of water in the milk solution = 4%

Amount of milk solution = 8 L

Required percentage of water content = 2%

**Calculation:**

⇒ Amount of water in the milk solution = 4% of 8 L = 4% of 8000 ml

⇒ Amount of water in the milk solution = (4)/(100)times 8000 = 320 ml

⇒ Pure milk in the solution = 8000 – 320 = 7680 ml

⇒ Let the amount of pure milk added in the solution be x ml.

⇒ According to the question,

⇒ (7680+x)/(8000+x)=(2)/(100)

⇒ 50 × (7680 + x) = 8000 + x

⇒ 384000 + 50x = 8000 + x

⇒ 50x – x = | 8000 – 384000 | = 376000

⇒ x = (376000)/(49)approx 8000ml

**Therefore, the amount of pure milk should be added in the solution to reduce water content to 2% is 8 L.**

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The locus of a point **equidistant** from two given points is the **perpendicular bisector** of the segment joining them.

Find the **midpoint** of (6, 2) and (4, 6): M = ((6+4)/2, (2+6)/2) = (5, 4).

Slope of the line joining points (m₁) = (6 − 2) ÷ (4 − 6) = 4 ÷ (−2) = −2.

Slope of **perpendicular bisector** (m₂) = −1 ÷ m₁ = 1/2.

Equation: y − 4 = 1/2 × (x − 5) ⇒ 2y − 8 = x − 5 ⇒ x − 2y = −3.

**∴ The correct answer is x − 2y = −3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Points **A(6, 2)** and **B(4, 6)**. Point **P(x, y)** is equidistant from A and B.

**Formula Used:** Distance between (x₁, y₁) and (x₂, y₂) = √[(x₂ − x₁)² + (y₂ − y₁)²]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e936686f93ba70afd7a88fe13a34614241a67fe2be139e3fa63bce60147553f9.png]

⇒ −12x + 8x − 4y + 12y = 52 − 40

⇒ −4x + 8y = 12

⇒ −4(x − 2y) = 12

⇒ x − 2y = 12 ÷ (−4)

⇒ x − 2y = −3

**∴ The correct answer is x − 2y = −3.**
